prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: a single finished landscape editorial illustration for the Chef Bob project on williswee.com/play, approximately 16:9, ideally 1536 x 864. Generate an entirely new illustration.
Primary request: Portray Chef Bob, an open-source AI skill that helps people plan household meals, adjust portions, and assemble a shopping list, as a welcoming imagined cook companion in the same handcrafted pixel-art world as Willis Wee's personal website. This is evocative project artwork, not an app screenshot.
Scene and composition: A cozy timber home kitchen beside the sea at blue hour, seen from a slightly elevated three-quarter viewpoint. Make the intimate kitchen activity the clear hero, not a distant building. A friendly adult cook with a simple small cream chef cap, cream apron and muted navy shirt stands behind a broad wooden counter, looking down with a relaxed expression as he plans dinner in an open recipe notebook. This is an original fictional character, not a portrait of a real person. His face, notebook, groceries and bowls form a clear large central focal cluster readable at small website sizes. One hand holds a pencil naturally above the notebook; the other rests on the counter.
Purposeful props: The open notebook shows three simple meal illustrations with short nonverbal line marks, beside a narrow paper shopping checklist with small checkboxes. A small basket of broccoli, carrots and tomatoes, a simple jar of rice, and two ceramic serving bowls make the household-meal idea tangible. Keep props few and grounded on surfaces. A gently steaming lidded pot sits on the stove just behind him. In the background, a small open window reveals a calm deep-blue sea and a distant sliver of dusk. A couple of herbs and wooden shelves complete the room without clutter.
Style: richly crafted high-end 1990s adventure-game pixel-art scenery with crisp square pixel clusters, visible hand-placed texture, controlled subtle dithering and beautiful depth. Warm amber lantern light on the cook and worktop, midnight navy and indigo shadows, restrained teal foliage, cream ceramics, honey-brown timber. Reference palette: ink #07101d, cream #f4e9cf, gold #ffbe63, subdued teal. Evoke a quiet, human, inviting place in a coastal pixel-art world. Detailed but coherent; expressive character anatomy, believable hands and perspective. The image should feel illustrated in pixels, never like a low-poly 3D render, smooth vector graphic or photorealistic image run through a pixel filter.
Framing: full-bleed wide composition. The cook occupies roughly a third of the image height or more; the counter activity fills the lower middle. Keep all meaningful content comfortably within the frame. A single scene, no panels or infographic layout.
Text: none. No title, letters, numbers, logos, UI, captions, watermarks, borders or promotional badges. Notebook contents are visual meal doodles, not readable writing.
Avoid: robots, holograms, app dashboards, floating objects, giant chef heads, uncanny hands, commercial restaurant branding, food delivery/order claims, health claims, excessive clutter, excessive tiny background detail, smooth anime shading.
